hero.headline: Focused on <hl>back-end</hl>. Learning through practice.
hero.subheadline: Software Engineering student at FIAP with a technical qualification in Systems Development. I'm building my foundation in Python and C#/.NET through web projects and technical support experience.

about.title: My journey so far.
about.p1: I'm Adriano Yudi Ribas Nishimoto, in the final semester of Software Engineering at FIAP, with graduation expected in December 2026. I also completed a technical course in Systems Development at Senac Hub Academy in November 2025.
about.p2: I'm interested in back-end development, especially REST APIs, CRUD operations, authentication and databases. At RINTEK, I contributed to an AI legal platform using Python, React and Supabase. At SAE+C, I provided technical support and helped implement Mhund, a school management system.
about.p3: Personal and academic projects help me practise programming and teamwork. My current level is intermediate in Python, basic to intermediate in C#/.NET and basic in JavaScript/TypeScript. I'm looking for opportunities to contribute, learn from a team and gain experience.
about.factLanguagesValue: Native Portuguese · Intermediate Spanish · Basic English (reading and comprehension: basic to intermediate) · Basic Japanese (self-reported N5 level)

services.description: I'd like to contribute to software projects and keep learning from a team. These are some of the activities I've had experience with.
services.s1Body: Helping build REST APIs with CRUD operations, validation, authentication and database access.
services.s2Body: Building screens and connecting them to APIs, drawing on academic projects and my experience at RINTEK.
services.s3Body: Helping people use systems, identifying issues and checking that features work as expected.
